title: Cresting the ridge above the cloud sea

tokens.v: Catch him mid-stride cresting the ridge, small in the lower third, the cloud sea and thin blue taking the rest of the height — jacket worn open, both front panels and the hem snapping downwind, grass laid flat in a travelling wave, hair pushed off his forehead. 35mm at f/8 from thirty metres out, below the trail line so he breaks the skyline. A lichen-crusted boulder blurs the near-right foreground, cut by the right and bottom edges. Dress him fully: charcoal ribbed merino crew, olive canvas trousers cuffed over brown lace-up leather hiking boots. Let the garment read unmarked.
